messages:
mike: Heads-up — I noticed a config drift between staging and prod overlays after the latest secrets rekey. staging has serviceaccount binding to `infra-runner-sa`, prod still references `old-runner-sa`. terraform plan shows delete/add for the secret path. Can someone sanity-check?

anna: Oof. Where did the rekey happen? CI or manual?

mike: rekey was part of last week's secret-migration PR (refs #432). Looks like overlay for prod wasn't rebased. I ran `terraform plan` against prod workspace and saw this snippet: 

```
- resource "kubernetes_secret" "app_keys" {
    id = "old/keys/path"
    data = {
      "REDWOOD_API_KEY" = "***"
    }
  }
+ resource "kubernetes_secret" "app_keys" {
    id = "kms:projects/.../new/path"
    data = {
      "REDWOOD_API_KEY" = "***"
    }
  }
```

mike: That id change is what's causing the overlay diff.

jessica: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the kustomize diff output (staging vs prod) if you have it? Quick way: `kustomize build overlays/prod | kubectl diff -f - --server-side` and same for staging.

mike: Tried that. staging diff is clean, prod shows the SA + secret path mismatch. Pasted minimal diff: 

```
Namespace/default
  Secret/app-keys
    - metadata.annotations.kms/key: projects/redwood/keys/old
    + metadata.annotations.kms/key: projects/redwood/keys/new
  ServiceAccount/app-runner
    - metadata.labels: { run: old }
    + metadata.labels: { run: infra-runner }
```

lee: Likely someone opened a prod overlay PR and it never merged. Quick question: Do we want to auto-accept the staging rekey into prod or run a controlled migration? This touches release gating.

mike: We should not auto-accept. Prod has stricter gating. Need a PR with canary rollout and QA signoff. But we also need to avoid accidental secret recreation.

devops-oncall: If we change secret id in place you'll get resource replace which will recreate secret in k8s. Suggest using SecretManager alias mapping first: create alias from old -> new then update overlay in a subsequent deploy.

anna: Good call. Steps: 1) create alias mapping in SecretManager (ops), 2) update prod overlay to reference alias, 3) run terraform plan with `-target` to avoid touching unrelated resources, 4) canary rollout on 1% pods, 5) promote. Anyone volunteer to cut the PR?

jessica: I can cut the PR and include docs in the PR description showing the plan commands and `kustomize build` diff. Will also add a `release-gate` tag so the gating script picks it up.

mike: Awesome — please ping me on the PR. Also add this check to the overlay lint job: error if `metadata.annotations.kms/key` differs between envs unless a migration flag exists.

lee: +1 on lint. Where does the lint live? repo: infra/ci/overlay-lint. I can add a quick python check that compares overlays/<env>/kustomization.yaml values.

infra-bot: deploy-checker: linked plan https://ci.internal.redwood/plan/8842 (prod workspace) — plan currently pending approval.

jessica: PR opened -> https://git.internal.redwood/p/infra/+/5678, includes kustomize diff and terraform plan screenshot. Tagging @mike for review, @devops-oncall for migration steps.

devops-oncall: Reviewed migration steps. I'll create the alias today at 15:30 UTC and post back. After alias exists, run `terraform apply -target=module.k8s_secret.app_keys` in prod with approval.

mike: Thanks. After apply, we'll run a smoke test: curl /health on canary pods and check logs for KMS access errors. If all good, promote.

anna: Adding task to release checklist: "overlay-secret-alias-created" and link to PR. Also adding a gating rule: block if prod overlay has unmerged changes for SA or secret ids.

lee: I'll open a follow-up PR to add the lint rule to infra/ci. Won't block this today.

mike: Great — closing the loop here. If anyone notices other env divergences run `./scripts/overlay-diff.sh staging prod` (added to repo utils) and attach to the PR. :white_check_mark:
